text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 5: For the six solar farms, an XGBoost model given ENS's mean alone has a mean absolute error of 8.8% of capacity at lead day 1 and 11.7% at lead day 4'
text.tspan: Figure 5: For the six solar farms, an XGBoost model given ENS's mean
alone has a mean absolute error of 8.8% of capacity at lead day 1 and

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean absolute error of each XGBoost model, in percent of capacity, with its 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed. The arms share their rows, so these intervals are wider than the paired differences in the headline figure, which cancel the month-to-month swing every arm shares. Each arm has two rows: the primary setting, and the sensitivity setting as a lighter hollow row. Arms are sorted best first at the primary setting. The six solar farms, up to 21 calendar months of out-of-fold forecasts. Every error is a fraction of the generator's own capacity, taken as its 99th percentile of metered output.'
text.tspan: Mean absolute error of each XGBoost model, in percent of capacity, with its 95% interval from resampling whole
months and a fitting seed. The arms share their rows, so these intervals are wider than the paired differences in
the headline figure, which cancel the month-to-month swing every arm shares. Each arm has two rows: the primary
setting, and the sensitivity setting as a lighter hollow row. Arms are sorted best first at the primary setting.
The six solar farms, up to 21 calendar months of out-of-fold forecasts. Every error is a fraction of the
generator's own capacity, taken as its 99th percentile of metered output.
